Bare five-year return is expressed as reference dollar/index gain 140.29, not fractional ROI 1.4029.
Accounting loss is negative in table; reference computes positive increase in loss magnitude, not change in signed value.
Removing a 261 buyout from a 4249 cash-use magnitude suggests subtraction, but reference adds. Total investing cash use is also not explicitly identical to capital expenditure.
Question says increase in total revenue; reference returns relative growth, not absolute 2775.
